title: MHRN minimal research object mapping
description: Minimal provenance mapping shared by research questions, hypotheses, experiments, DATA, EVID, claims, implementation objects and publication references. This schema intentionally does not instantiate a repository-wide master matrix.

axis.description: Research axis, for example empirical-technical, epistemological-methodological, or philosophical-ethical.

stage.description: Stage or cross-stage scope. Kept permissive while the stage taxonomy is still evolving.

object_type.description: Research object class such as research_question, hypothesis, experiment, data, evidence, claim, implementation, or publication.

evidence_mode.description: Declared evidence role such as confirmatory, exploratory, methodological, theoretical, or none.

status.description: Status of this object only; statuses from different object types must not be conflated.
